title: Chapter 320 The Big Chapter
content:
Chapter 320 The Big Chapter

And as Chu Lingsheng left, everyone became more and more nervous.

They see no hope of victory.

The next possibility is nothing more than killing them all by Chen Mingyu, or they all run away and go their separate ways.

Obviously, the latter has greater hope.

At this moment, Lu Xue suddenly said, "Hold me for a while."

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng did not hesitate at all and rushed towards Chen Mingyu without any hesitation.

Needless to say, Ao Qing relied on his powerful body to resist Chen Mingyu's attack.

Seeing the two of them playing with their lives, the rest of the audience were stunned.

What is this for?

Tang Hao frowned slightly, and saw Lu Xue slowly heading towards the huge bronze statue in the distance.

At this moment, the statue has begun to calm down.

After a moment of silence, Tang Hao said, "Hold Chen Mingyu."

After saying that, Tang Hao also rushed towards Chen Mingyu.

This scene made the rest of the people even more confused.

What exactly is this to be done and can you explain it clearly?

But even if they didn't understand, they rushed up.

They should have their reasons for doing this.

Facing the crowd of the Tiandi Academy, which was like a chicken blood, Chen Mingyu looked gloomy, but he was still sure to win.

The absolute advantage of the mid-stage Immortal Emperor Realm makes him extremely confident.

At the same time, Lu Xue has also arrived in front of the bronze statue.

Buzz —

Suddenly, the bronze statue trembled again.

The ancient ring in Lu Xue's hand was also responding to the bronze statue.

The next moment, under Lu Xue's surprised gaze, a beam of light containing mysterious power surged straight into Lu Xue's body.

For a moment, Lu Xue's eyes were lost and she was stunned.

But at this moment, Lu Xue's breath suddenly began to rise rapidly.

In the distance, everyone noticed Lu Xue's breath and was shocked.

At this moment, they suddenly remembered that Lu Xue was just the Immortal Lord Realm.

However, the Immortal Lord Realm can stand with them a group of Immortal Emperor Realm, and even pose a threat to the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

What a horrible monster this is.

Normally, shouldn’t the Immortal Lord Realm be just an ant in front of them?

After Chen Mingyu was shocked, his expression was extremely cold and his eyes were fixed on Lu Xue in the distance.

The next moment, Chen Mingyu ignored everyone present and rushed straight towards Lu Xue in the distance.

Seeing this scene, how could Xiao Luo and the others give up?

"If you want to touch the little master, you can pass my level first!"

"And me!"

"Don't think about it!"

Faced with everyone's obstruction, the silver spear in Chen Mingyu's hand became more and more fierce.

Bang bang bang!

As several terrifying attacks fell, Xiao Luo and his men were seriously injured and flew out.

Seeing Chen Mingyu approaching Lu Xue, a light flashed and Tang Hao blocked directly in front of Lu Xue.

"As angry as a mountain!"

Buzz —

A terrifying Xuanhuang aura overflowed from Tang Hao's body, and the next moment, the Xuanhuang aura began to spread instantly.

Immediately afterwards, a huge wall of air suddenly blocked Tang Hao.

"Tang Hao, you are looking for death!"

"Hmph, if it's a battle at the same level, I'll kill you like a dog!"

boom!

A gun flashed.

Tang Hao suddenly flew backwards, and a mouthful of essence and blood spurted out of his mouth.

Obviously, this move caused Tang Hao to suffer a lot.

But the effect is also very good.

Not only did he block Chen Mingyu's full-strength attack, he also bounced him back.

However, now everyone in Tiandi Academy has really tried their best.

Everyone, without exception, had a pale face.

"Ahem, damn it. If I had known that the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm was so strong, I would have broken through to the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm and come back."

Tang Hao said with some regret.

But he was just talking.

If he had really broken through to the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm at that time, he would not have been able to enter the ancient battlefield.

After all, the rule of the ancient battlefield is that it is not allowed to enter the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

However, it is OK to break through the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm in the ancient battlefield.

This is also a loophole in the ancient battlefield.

At this time, Chen Mingyu appeared in everyone's eyes again.

The full efforts of everyone to stop Chen Mingyu was just making Chen Mingyu's clothes slightly dirty, that's all.

Chen Mingyu sneered, "That's the end."

Immediately, Chen Mingyu rushed towards Lu Xue again.

This time, the academy was no longer able to stop.

Is it really that way?

Tang Hao covered his chest, took a breath, and shouted suddenly: "Ye Wuwei, Chu Xingyue, do you want to see Chen Mingyu's family dominant?!"

As soon as the words fell.

call out!

The sound of breaking through the air sounded.

Chen Mingyu's face changed slightly, and the spear in his hand suddenly turned around and swept out from behind.

bite!

I saw a flying knife blown out.

"Ye Wuwei!"

Chen Mingyu's face was cold.

I saw a figure slowly emerging in the distance.

It is Ye Wuwei who has long been hiding in the dark.

"Tsk tsk tsk tsk, Tang Hao, I really didn't expect that you would have such a miserable day."

At this moment, Ye Wuwei was still mocking Tang Hao.

However, Tang Hao said coldly: "If Junior Sister Lu Xue dies, then all of you will die."

Hearing this, Ye Wuwei was slightly stunned.

The rest of the people also looked puzzled.

Could it be that Tang Hao knows something?

Xiao Luo, Qin Feng, Ao Qing and others were shocked. Did Tang Hao know Sister Xue’s identity?

However, the reason why Tang Hao said this was just to scare Ye Wuwei.

But it's almost the same.

Judging from Lu Xue's attitude, once she succeeds, she may be very strong.

Even if Chen Mingyu cannot be defeated by then, it is OK to form a confrontation.

And if Lu Xue fails, no one will be able to deal with Chen Mingyu. At that time, all of them will either die or escape.

"I believe you once."

Ye Wuwei's expression also became solemn, and then rushed towards Chen Mingyu.

If Tang Hao was talking about others, he would naturally not believe it, but if it was Lu Xue, it would be different.

Because from the first sight of Lu Xue, he felt familiar.

It seems to have felt it from someone.

Forget it, I don’t think about it anymore. After all, I am a destiny man. What else can I do if I beat Chen Mingyu? Maybe I can break through in the battle again.

In this way, Ye Wuwei stared at the halo of destiny that did not exist and fought with Chen Mingyu.

After a moment.

"The long river of guns!"

"Damn!"

Bang!

Ye Wuwei flew backwards and was seriously injured.

Then, Chen Mingyu continued to rush towards Lu Xue.

At this time, Chu Xingyue came again.

At this moment, Chu Xingyue naturally would not watch Chen Mingyu deal with everyone and then dominate the whole family.

Immediately, Chu Xingyue fought with Chen Mingyu again.

"The long river of guns!"

"What!"

Bang!

Chu Xingyue flew backwards and was seriously injured.

In this way, except for Lu Xue and Chen Mingyu, everyone in the audience fell to the ground and were seriously injured.

"Damn it, is it over?"

At this moment, Chen Mingyu, as the winner, couldn't help but swear.

He has never been so speechless.

Do you really think he dare not kill him?

However, seeing that Lu Xue's breath became stronger and stronger in the distance, Chen Mingyu did not dare to hesitate anymore and hurried towards Lu Xue.

At this time, the two of them stood in front of Chen Mingyu again.

"Damn!"

"What are you doing? Aren't you seriously injured?!"

Seeing Xiao Luo, Qin Feng and Ao Qing blocking him, he was a little embarrassed.

Upon hearing this, Ao Qing snorted coldly, "Do you know what a magic medicine is?"

This is the background of his deserted city.

There are endless spiritual medicines and endless resources.

Only, spiritual medicine is not omnipotent. For example, if it is too strong, it takes time to recover with spiritual medicine.

This was also when Ao Qing and others took the spiritual medicine and recovered.

"Damn it, I see if you are dead this time!"

At this moment, Chen Mingyu looked at Xiao Luo and others and the murderous intent surged in his eyes.

At this moment, he didn't care about Xiao Luo's identity as the Xiao clan.

He was already red-eyed.

"Die for me!"

Seeing Chen Mingyu's terrifying attack, Xiao Luo gritted his teeth and used the imperial armor he had just obtained, and then went forward with his body.

boom!

A terrifying roar sounded, and Xiao Luo flew backwards, life and death unknown.

"The real and virtual are free to cut off!"

"Nine Dragons Step on the Sky!"

"The long river of guns!"

boom!

Without surprise, Qin Feng and Ao Qing were also bombarded with a blow.

In order to protect Lu Xue, everyone present was seriously injured.

"This time, no one can stop me."

"Bitch, die for me!"

Chen Mingyu's eyes had long been covered by the intention of killing, and at this moment his mind was full of killing Lu Xue to vent his anger.

But obviously, he couldn't do it.

"Yu."

Lu Xue opened her red lips lightly.

In an instant, an energy emitting terrifying cold suddenly appeared behind Lu Xue.

bite!

At this time, the gun arrived.

But no matter how hard Chen Mingyu tried, the silver spear could never make any progress.

Seeing this scene, he was a little panicked.

"you!"

At this time, Lu Xue slowly turned around, and the beautiful face that was fascinating to the whole country was already covered with frost.

"You, damn!"

The Xuanyuan Sword appeared in Lu Xue's hands.

The next moment, Lu Xue stabbed out with a sudden sword.

Bang!

I saw that Chen Mingyu, who was in the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm, was actually repelled by Lu Xue's sword.

Seeing this, everyone took a breath of cold air.

Could it be?

Sure enough, a breath of the Immortal Saint Realm suddenly overflowed from Lu Xue's body without any warning.

And this is not over yet.

Immediately afterwards, Lu Xue's breath began to rise again.

The first level of the Immortal Saint Realm.

The second level of the Immortal Saint Realm.

The third level of the Immortal Saint Realm.

.........

It was not until the ninth level of the Immortal Saint Realm that it was almost over.

At this moment, everyone stopped breathing and looked at Lu Xue blankly.

The needles falling in the field can be heard.

"Chen Mingyu, today next year is your death day!"

Lu Xue was extremely angry at this moment. She naturally knew everything about everyone protecting her.

This is the first time she has trusted her and protected her so unconditionally.

She was very moved.

At the same time, I also hated Chen Mingyu to the extreme.

In the distance, looking at Lu Xue, who was like a goddess in the sky, Ye Wuwei's eyes were a little dazed.

Who is the fucking destiny? !

Looking at Lu Xue who had almost been reborn, Chen Mingyu said gloomyly: "If you don't enter the Immortal Emperor Realm, you are just an ant after all. If you don't enter the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm, you can only look up to me forever."

Hearing that Chen Mingyu is still living in his own world, Tang Hao directly sprayed: "Sb one."

Ye Wuwei: "Agree."

Chu Xingyue didn't say anything, but her eyes looked at Chen Mingyu as if she was looking at a fool.

He can play two moves with you when he is in the Immortal Lord Realm. Now he is in the late stage of the Immortal Saint Realm, so he won’t take off directly.

"Is that true? Then let you see how far the world is."

Lu Xue was obviously also affected by the environment, and her words were becoming more and more impressive.

Soon, Lu Xue raised her sword and rushed towards Chen Mingyu.

Every move is full of strong aura.

Chen Mingyu couldn't resist it at all. The only advantage he had was that his combat awareness was higher than Lu Xue.

But in the face of absolute power, there is obviously some shortcomings.

Bang!

As the sword was slashed out, Chen Mingyu retreated hundreds of feet away, gasping heavily.

Logically speaking, even if Chen Mingyu lost, he would not lose so quickly.

But the previous consumption of dealing with Tang Hao and others was obviously a bit large.

Until now, he has not recovered.

"I said that today next year is your day!"

Lu Xue still said with a cold face.

Upon hearing this, Chen Mingyu looked unwilling, "How could I lose to you in the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm!"

At this moment, anger completely broke Chen Mingyu's brain.

The next moment, a blood-red pill appeared in Chen Mingyu's mouth.

This scene caused Tang Hao's face to change drastically.

"Breaking Pill, you're crazy!"

The rest of the people also showed horrified eyes.

Lu Xue frowned slightly, obviously not understanding what the Blade Pill is called.

At this time, Tang Hao quickly shouted: "Lu Xue, don't let him eat the Violent Pill!"

"The Violent Pill will greatly increase his strength in a short period of time!"

Hearing this, Lu Xue's expression trembled and quickly lifted her sword and rushed towards Chen Mingyu.

However, no matter how fast Lu Xue's speed is, how can she be so fast that she can stop Chen Mingyu from taking the pill?

As the entrance of the Violent Pill, Chen Mingyu's expression gradually became ferocious.

"All of you are going to die!"

boom!

Suddenly, Chen Mingyu's aura began to surge, and he reached the sixth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

At this moment, everyone's hearts fell to the bottom.

It's over.

boom!

At this time, Chen Mingyu shot and stabbed Lu Xue with a shot.

As the dazzling gun light surged out, Lu Xue immediately retreated and her arms became even more numb.

It has become so much stronger.

However, this pill cannot have no side effects.

Tang Hao explained this again.

"Lu Xue, the Blazing Pill is to overdraw his body for strength. In other words, although he is very strong now, his body is not as good as before. If you can hurt him, you may still have a chance."

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded.

She only thought of one way.

Replace injuries with injuries.

However, it is a bit possible whether her body can last until Chen Mingyu falls down.

As Lu Xue raised her sword again.

The scene began to rumble again.

The swords and guns kept roaring.

The entire bronze palace was trembling slightly.

After a while, Lu Xue's injuries were getting worse and worse, and although Chen Mingyu was also injured, he could obviously support it.

Bang!

As Lu Xue was knocked back again, there was a sniffle.

Lu Xue suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood.

She has really tried her best.

Still lost?

Lu Xue was a little unwilling to accept it.

At this time, Chen Mingyu was almost laughing wildly and slowly walked towards Lu Xue.

"If you want to kill me, are you worthy?"

"From today, my Chen Mingyu's name will resound throughout the entire fairyland. No one in this world can stop it,"

laugh!

At this moment, a piece of black sharp blade suddenly pierced through Chen Mingyu's heart, revealing a large piece of his chest, and the blood instantly dyed Chen Mingyu's clothes red.

Chen Mingyu's eyes widened, his expression had already frozen.

He looked back with difficulty, his expression was extremely unwilling and a little bit of surprise.
